mapper.select: WITH latest_token_quotes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, candle_time DESC ), wallet_stats AS ( SELECT w.wallet_id, w.bank_name, w.account_no, w.cash_balance, COALESCE(SUM(h.purchased_value), 0) AS total_purchased_value, COALESCE(SUM(h.token_balance * ltq.closing_price), 0) AS total_market_value FROM wallets w LEFT JOIN holdings h ON w.wallet_id = h.wallet_id LEFT JOIN latest_token_quotes ltq ON h.token_id = ltq.token_id WHERE w.wallet_id = #{walletId} GROUP BY w.wallet_id, w.bank_name, w.account_no, w.cash_balance ) SELECT bank_name AS bankName, account_no AS accountNo, cash_balance AS cashBalance, total_purchased_value AS totalPurchasedValue, total_market_value AS totalMarketValue, (cash_balance + total_market_value) AS totalBalance, (total_market_value - total_purchased_value) AS profitLoss, CASE WHEN total_purchased_value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_market_value - total_purchased_value) / total_purchased_value * 100 END AS profitLossRate FROM wallet_stats

WITH latest_token_quotes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, candle_time DESC ) SELECT t.token_name AS tokenName, t.ticker_symbol AS tickerSymbol, h.token_balance AS tokenBalance, h.purchased_value AS purchasedValue, (h.token_balance * ltq.closing_price) AS marketValue, (h.token_balance * ltq.closing_price) - h.purchased_value AS profitLoss, CASE WHEN h.purchased_value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((h.token_balance * ltq.closing_price) - h.purchased_value) / h.purchased_value * 100 END AS profitLossRate FROM holdings h JOIN tokens t ON h.token_id = t.token_id LEFT JOIN latest_token_quotes ltq ON h.token_id = ltq.token_id WHERE h.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY t.token_name LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * 10

SELECT MIN(th.created_at) AS createdAt, CASE WHEN th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND MAX(o.order_side) = 'BUY' THEN 'BUY' WHEN th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND MAX(o.order_side) = 'SELL' THEN 'SELL' ELSE th.transaction_type::text END AS transactionType, COALESCE(MAX(t.token_name), '-') AS tokenName, COALESCE(MAX(t.ticker_symbol), '-') AS tickerSymbol, CASE WHEN th.transaction_type = 'PASS' THEN SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'OUT' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END) END AS executedAmount, CASE WHEN th.transaction_type = 'PASS' THEN SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'TOKEN' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'TOKEN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END) END AS executedVolume, CASE WHEN th.transaction_type IN ('TRADE', 'PASS') THEN COALESCE( (SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'OUT' THEN th.amount WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN -th.amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'TOKEN' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS executedPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' THEN th.balance_after ELSE 0 END) AS balanceAfter
FROM transaction_hists th LEFT JOIN orders o ON th.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN tokens t ON o.token_id = t.token_id WHERE th.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND th.transaction_type IN ('TRADE', 'PASS', 'FAIL', 'DIVIDEND', 'BURN')
GROUP BY CASE WHEN th.transaction_type IN ('TRADE', 'PASS') THEN CAST(th.trade_id AS CHAR) WHEN th.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(th.order_id AS CHAR) ELSE CAST(th.transaction_id AS CHAR) END, th.transaction_type
ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
